retrievalProfile.description: A moody, Victorian-inspired interior featuring a central figure in dark formal wear against ornate wood paneling and patterned rugs, topped with intricate beaded or dripping typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, low-key photograph of a woman in a black corset and skirt seated at a dark wood piano or harmonium. The setting is a rich, dimly lit room with gold-trimmed wall panels and a complex Persian-style rug. The typography is highly stylized, appearing as if constructed from hanging beads or jewelry.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject seated diagonally across the frame from left to right
Dark wood furniture anchoring the left foreground
Ornate wall paneling providing a structured geometric background
Typography integrated into the upper right negative space
coreInvariants: Intricate, beaded or jewelry-like texture on display text
Contrast between formal Victorian decor and casual footwear

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is seated centrally, leaning back, occupying the middle ground from the left-center to the lower-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, heavy wood of the piano on the left serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the subject's body from the face down to the feet, then moves up to the decorative text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant is utilized for the complex typographic element against the dark wall panels.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks (furniture, clothing, shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Gold and ochre (wall trim, rug patterns, highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the subject's skin and the dark environment.
paletteRestrictions: Limit palette to earth tones and metallic golds

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Elongated, condensed serif with Art Nouveau influences
letterConstructionRules: Characters are outlined with small, circular bead-like dots
Vertical strokes feature long, dripping extensions resembling hanging jewelry
Variable line weights created by clusters of beads
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders are exaggerated into decorative vertical lines
The 'V' and 'H' serve as larger anchors for the beaded texture

anatomy.weight: thin skeleton with thick beaded outlines

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single complex decorative style used for all text to maintain the jewelry-like aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, flowing structure of the base letterforms.
Captures the specific material quality of the reference.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a moody photograph of a woman in a black corset and skirt sitting at a dark Victorian piano in a room with gold-trimmed wood panels and a green/gold Persian rug.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom vector lettering in the top right corner using a beaded, dripping gold style with elongated vertical strokes.

verificationChecks: Does the text look like it is made of hanging beads?
Is the lighting low-key and warm?
Is the subject's pose diagonal and relaxed?

adjustableVariables: Length of the dripping vertical strokes
mustRedesign: Avoid using standard fonts without the beaded modification
Ensure the background is not a flat color but a textured interior

mustAchieve: Tactile, jewelry-like quality in the typography
Rich, atmospheric depth in the background

postGenerationChecks: Check for beaded texture on all letterforms
Verify the presence of gold-trimmed wood panels
Ensure the rug has a complex, aged pattern
Confirm the lighting creates deep shadows and warm highlights
recipe.reuseFormula: Victorian Interior + Corset Fashion + [Beaded Dripping Typography] = Gothic Chamber Pop Aesthetic
